_note: SEED rows describe the SHAPE of a code-search eval set over the REAL indexed mnemosyne corpus (repository_id = the repo dir, file_path = repo-relative). Each row is query -> the relevant FILE PATH(s); a hit on ANY relevant path in the top-k counts as recall. Paths are matched case-insensitively (leading ./ stripped) by the bake-off scorer. These 50 rows point at files that exist in THIS repo today, but they are a SEED, not a frozen held-out set: before the AC-030 bake-off decision the OPERATOR must (1) confirm each relevant path is the truly-relevant file for the query (a human picks it), (2) EXPAND toward representative coverage of the live corpora the tool indexes (nodex + mnemosyne), and (3) freeze it. The research caveat applies: validate Voyage's paper numbers on YOUR TS repo — this set IS that instrument, so keep labels honest.
_archetypes: where-is-X (subsystem location), how-do-we-X (mechanism), symbol-lookup (named function/type), route->handler trace, cross-file usage. The `archetype` field on each row is informational only (the loader ignores it).
_expand: Operator: add rows until coverage is representative (target 80-150 for a stable number), then set _seed=false and freeze. The DB-backed code-recall.test.ts asserts the chosen-arm baseline once frozen.
